headword: {古今和歌集|こきんわかしゅう}
gloss: the Kokin Wakashu (first imperial waka anthology)

definitions.gloss: the Kokin Wakashu (anthology of waka, c. 905)
definitions.explanation: The first anthology of waka poetry compiled by imperial command, in the early tenth century, by Ki no Tsurayuki and others. Its roughly 1,100 poems and its preface set the model of courtly taste for centuries. Often called {古今集|こきんしゅう}.

{古今和歌集|こきんわかしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平安時代|へいあんじだい}→平安時代：31041_heianjidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{編|あ}まれた→編む：00002_amu⟧。
examples.english: The Kokin Wakashu was compiled in the Heian period.
